sos.audioBody: Yakadzimwa kunze kwekunge waibatidza. Panguva yeSOS foni yako inorekodha zvainonzwa yozvitumira kuchikwata chekuchengeteka cheSiham chete, muzvikamu zveminiti.

identity.intro: Nzendo dzevakadzi chete ndedzevakadzi vatakasimbisa identity yavo, saka hapana anogona kupinda nekungoti mukadzi. Tumira mufananidzo wenational ID yako, passport kana driving licence, pamwe neselfie. Admin weSiham anotarisa kuti selfie ndeyako, kazhinji mukati mezuva rimwe. ID inoratidza kuti ndiwe ani; gender yako ndiyo yaunorarama nayo. Mifananidzo inoonekwa nechikwata chedu chete uye inobviswa kana tangopedza kuita sarudzo.

help.requestsYouSendAppearHere: Zvikumbiro zvaunotumira zvinooneka pano pamwe nemhinduro dzedu.

t1.a1: Kana mutyairi agamuchira chikumbiro chako. Vatyairi vane maawa 6 ekupindura; chikumbiro chisingapindurwi nenguva, kana rwendo rwatobva, chinopera uye mari yose yakabhadharwa inodzorerwa.
t1.a2: Chikumbiro chinobhadharwa neEcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks kana kadhi chisina kubhadharwa mukati memaminitsi 15 chinokanzurwa. Kana mubhadharo ukazofamba mushure meizvozvo, mari inoenda muSiham wallet yako. Kana mari yabviswa muaccount yako asi isiri muwallet, vhura chikumbiro pasi pePayment pazasi uye tichaitevera.
t1.a3: Mutyairi asati agamuchira, mari yose. Mushure meizvozvo, kazhinji: mari yose kana uchikanzura maawa 24 kana kupfuura rwendo rusati rwabva, hafu kubva pamaawa 2, uye hapana mushure meizvozvo. Kukanzura mukati memaminitsi 30 mutyairi agamuchira hakuna muripo, kana rwendo ruchine awa kana kupfuura rusati rwabva. App inoratidza mari chaiyo usati wasimbisa. Kana mutyairi akachinja nguva kana kukanzura, unodzorerwa mari yose.
t1.a4: Inoenda muSiham wallet yako pakarepo, zvisinei nekuti wakabhadhara sei. Ishandise parwendo rwako runotevera, kana kuibvisa kuEcoCash, OneMoney kana InnBucks pasi peSettings, Wallet; munhu anogadzirisa withdrawals, kazhinji mukati mezuva rimwe rebasa.
t1.a5: Hongu, kana ZiG iripo pachidzitiro chekubhadhara. Mitengo inoiswa muUS dollars yozoshandurwa nerate inoratidzwa usati wabhadhara.

t2.a1: Pachidzitiro cherwendo, bata Share trip. Munhu wese ane link anogona kutevera motokari asina app kusvika awa rimwe mushure mekunge wasvika.
t2.a2: Dzvanya wobata bhatani reSOS kwemasekonzi 3. Chikwata chekuchengeteka cheSiham chinoziviswa pakarepo uye chinogona kuona pauri. Mushure memasekonzi gumi vanhu vako vekufonera panjodzi vanowana meseji ine link yenzvimbo yako live, kunze kwekunge wakanzura nekuti wakadzvanya netsaona. Kana uri munjodzi, fonerawo {{number}} (mapurisa {{police}}, amburenzi {{ambulance}}).
t2.q3: Ko kana ndisina network kana GPS?
t2.a3: Chenjedzo ichiri kuenda: kana GPS isina kuwana nzvimbo tinoshandisa nzvimbo yekupedzisira yemotokari. Kana pasina data zvachose, app inoramba ichiedza uye inokupa sarudzo yekutumira meseji kuvanhu vako kubva pafoni yako nekufonera nhamba yekukurumidzira.
t2.a4: Panzendo refu tinokutarisa pamaminitsi 30 oga oga. Kana ukasapindura kaviri, chikwata chedu chekuchengeteka chinoziviswa, uye kana ukasapindura mukati memaminitsi 5 tinotumira meseji kuvanhu vako vekufonera panjodzi.
t2.a5: Kana mutyairi akakanzura, unodzorerwa mari yose otomatiki. Kana asina kumbosvika, bata rwendo muNzendo dzangu wosarudza Taura dambudziko.

t3.a1: Pakarepo mushure merwendo, kana gare gare kubva paNzendo dzangu; nzendo dzausina kupa chiyero dzinomakwa Rate. Kupihwa kwezviyero kunovhara mazuva 7 mushure merwendo. Maonero akanyorwa anooneka mushure mekunge chikwata chedu chaatarisa.
t3.a2: MuNzendo dzangu, bata rwendo wosarudza Risiti. Unogonawo kuzvitumira neemail.
t3.a3: Bata rwendo muNzendo dzangu wosarudza Taura dambudziko. Chikwata chedu chinoongorora mukati memaawa 48 kusvika 72 chichitarisa hurukuro yerwendo, mibhadharo nenzira.

t4.a1: Tinoongorora licence yako, registration neinsurance mukati memaawa 48. Kana pane chisina kujeka tinokumbira kuti ukwidze gwaro iroro zvakare.
t4.a2: Tinokurudzira mutengo zvichienderana nedaro nemotokari yako, uchikwira zvishoma panguva dzakawanda dzekuenda nekudzoka kubasa uye kana vanhu vakawanda vachitsvaga. Unogona kusarudza chero mutengo uri mukati me30% kubva pane watakurudzira.
t4.a3: Magwaro akabvumidzwa, nzendo 20, chiyero che4.7 kana kupfuura kubva kuvafambi vanosvika 10, kukanzura kushoma, mazuva 90 nesu uye record yakachena. Profile yako inoratidza mafambiro ako.
t4.a4: Chikamu chako chemari yerwendo chinowedzerwa kana wapedza rwendo. Ma statement emwedzi ari pachidzitiro cheEarnings.

impact.coSavedInEachOf: CO₂ yakachengetedzwa mumwedzi mumwe nemumwe yemitanhatu yapfuura
impact.everyTripYouShareAs: Rwendo rumwe nerumwe rwaunogoverana, semufambi kana mutyairi, runochengetedza CO₂ yaizobuda kana mumwe munhu aityaira ega. Zvawakachengetedza zvinooneka pano mushure merwendo rwako rwekutanga rwapera.
impact.litresOne: Anenge CO₂ inobuda pakupisa litre 1 repeturu
impact.litresMany: Anenge CO₂ inobuda pakupisa malitre {{count}} epeturu
impact.method1: Parwendo rumwe nerumwe rwakagoverwa tinoyera chikamu chenzira chemufambi. Dai akatyaira ega, avhareji yemotokari inoburitsa anenge {{kg}} kg eCO₂ pakiromita. Pakugoverana, anongoverengerwa chikamu chezvigaro zvake mumotokari yaafamba nayo, zvichiverengwa kubva pakukura kwemotokari uye kuti vanhu vangani vaivemo. Musiyano ndiwo unochengetedzwa, uye unoverengerwa mufambi nemutyairi vose.
impact.method2: Iyi ifungidziro. Tinoverenga motokari imwe pabooking, zvisinei nekuti ine zvigaro zvingani; hativerengi kutsauswa kudiki kwemutyairi achienda kunotora mufambi; uye tinofungidzira kuti mufambi angadai akatyaira. Dai waizotora kombi kana bhazi, wakachengetedza zvishoma pane izvi.
